literal: In feigned anger there is there a sorrow, 'uniting prolonging is it not [doubt]?' thinking.
translation: Even in a lovers' quarrel there is a certain sorrow, born of the anxious thought that their coming together might be delayed.
modern: ஊடலிலும், மீண்டும் ஒன்று சேருவது தாமதமாகுமோ என்று எண்ணுவதால் ஒரு துன்பம் இருக்கிறது.
explanation: This couplet captures the delicate psychological state of a lover during a feigned quarrel (ஊடல்). Although such a quarrel is meant to eventually enhance the pleasure of union, it brings its own subtle sorrow (துன்பம்). This pain arises from the anxious thought (என்று) that the time taken to finally reunite (புணர்வது) might be prolonged (நீடுவது). The particles of doubt (அன்று கொல்) perfectly express the lover's hesitation and fear of an extended separation.
